messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: There is a pregnancy exposure registry for women who use Wegovy during pregnancy.
The purpose of this registry is to collect information about the health of you and your baby.
Talk to your healthcare provider about how you can take part in this registry.
Contact Novo Nordisk at 1-877-390-2760 or www.wegovypregnancyregistry.com.
Breastfeeding:
Ask a doctor if it is safe to breastfeed while using Ozempic or Wegovy injections.
Breastfeeding is not recommended during treatment with Wegovy tablets.
You should not breastfeed while using Rybelsus.
Triplet: ["Wegovy tablets", "has breastfeeding warning", "breastfeeding is not recommended during treatment"]

The relation 'has breastfeeding warning' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug includes a caution or warning about the safety of breastfeeding, as specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has pregnancy or breastfeeding warning': The subject drug carries the warning specified by the object entity regarding use during pregnancy or while breastfeeding.
B. 'has warning': The subject drug carries a safety warning or precaution about the risk or situation specified by the object entity.
C. 'should be used with caution with': The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision when used with the object entity.
D. 'has breastfed baby dose': The subject drug is received by the breastfed baby in the dose amount specified by the object entity.
E. 'use with caution in': The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
